survival.Notes: Female Swiss albino mice, 1e6 EAC cells i.p. (ascitic) or 1e6 S180 cells s.c. into the right hind leg; treatment started 9 days after inoculation, six mice per group. Table 5 reports mean survival time (MST) and the author T/C (%); medians are not given. Untreated controls: EAC 22 +/- 1.7 days, S180 53 +/- 4.3 days. DMSO vehicle controls (EAC i.p. 23 days / T/C 104.5; S180 i.t. 56 / 105.6; S180 i.m. 54 / 101.8) are kept here and not entered as compound rows. The scale on which MST is counted is not stated (inoculation or first dose), so Time_origin is unknown; the EAC control MST of 22 days is compatible with either. Number of injections is not stated, so schedule is left empty. SD of each MST is in this note: EAC 20 mg/kg 25 +/- 2.0; 30 mg/kg 33 +/- 2.7; 40 mg/kg 21 +/- 1.7; 50 mg/kg 20 +/- 1.8; S180 i.t. 20 mg/kg 53 +/- 3.8; 30 mg/kg 68 +/- 5.2; 40 mg/kg 59 +/- 4.0; 50 mg/kg 47 +/- 3.5; S180 i.m. 5 mg/kg 86 +/- 7.1; 10 mg/kg 79 +/- 6.7; 15 mg/kg 64 +/- 5.1. For the EAC groups Table 5 also gives total ascitic fluid and packed cell volume (untreated 13.5 ml / 8.0 ml; 20 mg/kg 11.5 / 6.2; 30 mg/kg 7.9 / 4.7; 40 mg/kg 12.7 / 7.6; 50 mg/kg 13.3 / 7.9); these ascitic-load endpoints have no column in the current schema and are not entered as tumour volume or weight.
